steps.do: Before you start: start CALIBER with CALIBER_FEATURE_RELEASE_CANDIDATES=true and a second account in CALIBER_OPERATOR_USERS. Check GET /capabilities shows the flag enabled, create the workspace, and read GET /projects/{id}/environments.
steps.see: Four seeded environments -- dev, qa, staging, prod -- and only dev starts active.
source_mode: caliber_managed with a null source and no connection: managed snapshots need no Git. The Git import path (POST .../revision-imports) refuses with 409 workspace_source_not_configured.

steps.do: Author a prompt and give it a second version; create a test set. These are the entities the revision will pin.
steps.see: An ordinary prompt with versions 1 and 2, and a test set at version 1.

steps.do: Snapshot revision R1: POST /projects/{id}/revisions:snapshot with two pins -- the prompt at version_ref "1" and the test set at "1". Repeat the identical request.
steps.see: A managed, ready revision -- and the identical request returns the identical revision id: snapshots are idempotent by content.

steps.do: Snapshot R2 with the prompt pinned at version_ref "2" (the test set unchanged).
steps.see: A new revision id with revision_number one higher.

steps.do: Diff them: GET .../revisions/{R2}/diff?base={R1}. Also try a pin with resource_type: knowledge_base.
steps.see: Exactly one changed pin (the prompt), nothing added or removed. The unsupported type is refused with 409 resource_type_adapter_unavailable; a viewer's snapshot is 403.

steps.do: Create a change request on R2 (semantic_version 1.0.0, review_backend caliber, the reviewer assigned) and :submit it.
steps.see: Status open; the semver claim is reserved at creation.

steps.do: Try to review it as its author, then review it as the assigned second person (POST .../reviews {"head_id": ..., "decision": "approve"}).
steps.see: The author is refused: 403 self_review_forbidden. The reviewer's approval makes it technically_approved.

steps.do: Create a release of R2 into dev (three 64-hex content digests, an idempotency key), replay the same key, then POST .../evaluate.
steps.see: A draft release; the replay returns the same release; evaluate moves it to evaluating with the evaluation queued while this lab leaves the evaluator flag off. An enabled worker requires complete digest-matching pins.

steps.do: Read the refusals that guard everything beyond the boundary: :accept on the change request, quality-signoff and operations {"kind": "apply"} on the release.
steps.see: 409 qa_go_decision_required, 409 machine gate evidence is missing, 409 only an approved release can be applied -- and snapshot_workspace_revision, create_workspace_change_request, submit_workspace_change_request in the audit log. Version tags stay empty: only an accept mints one.
